name: nexus-indesign
description: Adobe InDesign for Claude Code and Codex through its COM automation only (no panel, no UXP plugin, no network): open, script, preview, preflight and export, every change backed up and checked. Starts the native NexusInDesign engine installed by NexusSystem (or NexusInDesign's get.ps1).

interface.shortDescription: Create with scripts, verify in InDesign
interface.longDescription: A studio workflow for Adobe InDesign 2024 to 2026: reproducible UXP scripts to create and edit documents, then local MCP tools to inspect, preflight, render and verify the final result. Driven through COM only, every change backed up first.
